channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Turkish Cypriot leader to urge Cyprus talk overhaul in meeting with UN chief
item.description: Turkish Cypriot leader Tufan Erhürman will meet U.N. Secretary-General Antonio Guterres on Feb. 11 to present proposals for a revised negotiation methodology should talks resume on the ethnically divided island.

item.title: Solar, wind capacity growth slowed last year: Analysis
item.description: Planned or under-construction solar and wind projects slowed last year, analysis showed Tuesday, casting doubts on whether countries will hit a goal of tripling renewable capacity by decade-end.

item.title: Defying odds, surgeons restore limbs after deadly Antalya bus crash
item.description: Two victims of a deadly bus crash in Antalya have regained severed limbs after undergoing complex, hours-long surgeries that doctors initially said would not be possible.

item.title: Smoking kills nearly 100,000 a year in Türkiye as new restrictions loom
item.description: Around 300 people die every day in Türkiye from smoking-related causes, amounting to nearly 100,000 preventable deaths annually, an expert warns, as authorities prepare to expand anti-tobacco regulations in public spaces.

item.title: Tourism industry upbeat as it targets new records in 2026
item.description: The Turkish tourism industry is confident that the targets set for 2026 could be reached despite geopolitical hurdles.

item.title: Netanyahu due in US to reshape Iran talks
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was set to head to the United States on Feb. 10 to meet U.S. President Donald Trump at the White House, in a trip seen as aiming to influence the ongoing talks between Washington and Tehran on Iran’s nuclear program.

item.title: US judge drops deportation case against Turkish student
item.description: A U.S. immigration judge terminated removal proceedings on Feb. 9 against Turkish graduate student Rümeysa Öztürk, ending the government’s efforts to deport her nearly a year after she was arrested by U.S. immigration agents.

item.title: Türkiye sees no imminent risk of Iran-US war: FM
item.description: Türkiye does not see an imminent risk of war between Iran and the United States and believes diplomacy still offers a viable path forward, Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said on Feb. 9.

item.title: Türkiye, Saudi Arabia to jointly produce Gökbey helicopters
item.description: Türkiye signed a memorandum of understanding with Saudi Arabia on Feb. 10 to jointly produce its Gökbey general-purpose helicopters in the kingdom, marking the first international manufacturing deal for the aircraft.

item.title: Erdoğan, Mitsotakis to chair high-level council meeting in Ankara
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan and Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis will co-chair the sixth Türkiye-Greece High-Level Cooperation Council meeting in the capital Ankara on Feb. 11, aiming to strengthen bilateral relations and ensure calm and stability in the Aegean Sea.
